news.title: Nium Acquires Cypher to Integrate Crypto Wallets Into Cross-Border Payments Stack
news.body: Nium has acquired Cypher, adding crypto-native wallet and issuing capabilities to its global payments infrastructure. This positions Nium to offer seamless fiat-to-crypto money movement for enterprise clients, directly challenging legacy cross-border payment processors and banks. Payment processors and banks now face a new competitor able to bridge regulated fiat rails with digital asset flows. Nium aims to serve B2B payouts and treasury use cases where stablecoins and instant settlement are gaining traction.

news.title: Equifax Buys Mexico’s Fastest-Growing Credit Bureau for $750M, Escalating LatAm Data Wars
news.body: Equifax is acquiring Círculo de Crédito for $750 million, expanding its reach in Latin America’s competitive credit data market. The deal puts pressure on local and regional bureaus as Equifax brings global data standards and analytics to Mexican lenders and fintechs. Incumbent bureaus may lose share or face consolidation as international players scale up. Regulatory scrutiny is likely as market concentration increases and cross-border data flows intensify.

news.title: Hyundai Card Completes Stablecoin Pilot With Avalanche and Tether, Visa Joins Next Phase
news.body: Hyundai Card finished a real-world stablecoin pilot using Avalanche and Tether, with Visa and Circle set to participate in the next stage. This marks one of the first mainstream card issuers to test stablecoin settlement at scale, signaling a shift toward programmable money in consumer payments. Traditional card networks and banks now face a credible path for stablecoins to bypass legacy rails. Regulators and merchant acquirers will need to address compliance and acceptance as Visa’s involvement expands.

news.title: Sony Wins OCC Conditional Trust Charter to Launch Stablecoin-Focused Connectia Trust
news.body: Sony received conditional approval from the OCC for a trust charter, clearing the way to launch Connectia Trust for stablecoin issuance and management. This move brings a global tech giant into direct competition with banks and fintechs in the regulated stablecoin space. U.S. banks and payment firms now face a new breed of issuer with deep tech and consumer reach. Sony must now secure full regulatory approval and attract institutional partners to establish Connectia’s presence in the market.

news.title: Visa Launches Mobile-First Travel Platform, Expanding Beyond Payments Into Loyalty and Services
news.body: Visa is rolling out a travel-focused mobile platform in ten countries, bundling payments with loyalty, booking, and travel assistance features. This expansion challenges incumbent travel platforms and deepens Visa’s direct relationship with international travelers. Competing travel fintechs and banks risk losing share as Visa leverages its network to embed financial services at the point of travel. Visa’s ability to drive user engagement beyond payments will determine the platform’s long-term impact.

perspective: Nium and Visa drive cross-border and stablecoin innovation as Sony enters U.S. trust banking with Connectia Trust.
